testing_progress.highlight: bogota-devnet-1 running but lightly stressed; spamoor struggles with consistent Frame transaction throughput
RPC inconsistencies across clients blocking Frame transaction data retrieval; API specs not finalized
No clients have implemented tracing APIs yet; Explorer needs call traces (debug_traceBlockByHash) to inspect frames

eip_proposals_bogota.highlight: max_fee PR to EIP-8141 (PR #12414), drawing on EIP-7999: unified fee cap across execution/state/blob dimensions; broad conceptual support, Daniil raised fee-access opcode interaction concern still unresolved
PR #12502: bound arbitrary signature object length in canonical hash to prevent relay-padding cost attack; no opposition, plan to merge post-call
PR #12530 (7906): proposes removing the TXDIFF opcode in favor of TXTRACE; deferred after Alex raised a pre-state proxy slot use case not coverable by TXTRACE alone

eip_proposals_hegota.highlight: Spencer proposed adding to bogota-devnet-2: EIP-8131, EIP-8279, EIP-8253 (nonce bump), EIP-8298 (SETCODEFROM), EIP-4758 (deactivate SELFDESTRUCT); Iván added EIP-8151; process/scope TBD at ACDT
Offchain Labs (Justin Zen) proposed VERIFY_NONSTATE + VERIFY_STATE frame modes to separate stateless signature verification from stateful checks, saving L2 sequencer re-verification

organizational.highlight: "nonce" preferred over "nonce_seq" for Frame transaction field naming; at least 3 clients aligned, Besu abstaining pending further thought
Next devnet remains bogota-devnet-2 (EL-only); combined Hegota devnet deferred; scope to be decided at Thursday's call before Mumbai travel
